User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the Omuto Central application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

role.description: The user's role within the organization (e.g., Program Manager, Operations, Media, ED, Intern, Volunteer).

photoURL.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the user profile was created.

Program.title: Program
Program.description: Represents a core program or initiative of Omuto Foundation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the program entity.

title.description: The title of the program (e.g., RED Campaign).

description.description: A brief description of the program.

lead.description: The name of the team member leading the program.

status.description: The current status of the program.

deadline.description: The target completion date for the program.

objectives.description: A list of key objectives for the program.

valuePerObjective.description: The monetary value (in UGX) assigned to completing one objective of this program.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the program was created.

Partnership.title: Partnership
Partnership.description: Represents a partnership with another organization, including intake and assessment data.

name.description: The name of the partner organization.

focusAreas.description: Key operational areas of the partner (e.g., Education, Health).

contactPerson.description: The primary contact at the partner organization.

contactRole.description: The role of the primary contact.

contactPhone.description: The phone number of the primary contact.

contactEmail.description: The email address of the primary contact.

offers.description: What the partner offers (e.g., Funding, Expertise).

receives.description: What Omuto offers in return (e.g., Community Access, Implementation).

financialValue.description: The estimated annual financial value (UGX) of the partnership.

inKindValue.description: Description of the in-kind value (e.g., Equipment, Volunteers).

strategicValue.description: Description of the strategic value (e.g., Access to new schools).

riskLevel.description: The assessed risk level of the partnership.

status.description: The current status of the partnership.

health.description: The overall health of the partnership.

nextStep.description: The next actionable step for this partnership.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the partnership was created.

lastContacted.description: Server timestamp of the last interaction with the partner.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Represents a specific activity or task performed by Omuto staff, logged via the ROI Calculator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the activity entity.

userId.description: Reference to User who logged the activity.

userName.description: Name of the user who logged the activity.

title.description: The title of the activity (e.g., Tree Planting at St. Mary's).

ecosystem_phase.description: The ecosystem phase this activity belongs to.

primaryGoalType.description: The type of the primary goal (either a KPI Metric or a Program objective).

primaryGoalId.description: The ID of the selected Metric or Program.

primaryGoalQuantity.description: The quantity achieved for the primary goal (e.g., number of students, number of objectives).

directValue.description: The direct value generated by the activity's primary goal.

indirectValue.description: The additional value from ROI multipliers.

estimatedRoi.description: The estimated Return on Investment percentage.

finalRoi.description: The final Return on Investment percentage after the activity.

loggedAt.description: Server timestamp of when the activity was logged.

parents_attended.description: Number of parents reached in a RED Campaign session.

teachers_attended.description: Number of teachers reached in a RED Campaign session.

trees_planted.description: Number of trees planted during a GreenSchools activity.

memorableMoment.description: A memorable moment from the activity.

beneficiaryQuote.description: A direct quote from a beneficiary.

SchoolVisit.title: School Visit
SchoolVisit.description: Represents a specific M&E school visit for the RED Campaign.

programId.description: The ID of the program (e.g., RED Campaign).

objectivesMet.description: Which specific objectives of the visit were achieved.

challengesObserved.description: Any challenges or blockers observed during the visit.

userId.description: ID of the user who submitted the report.

TreeSurvivalSurvey.title: Tree Survival Survey
TreeSurvivalSurvey.description: Represents a follow-up survey to track tree survival for GreenSchools.

originalPlantingActivityId.description: The ID of the initial tree planting activity.

notes.description: Observations on why trees survived or did not.

userId.description: ID of the user who submitted the survey.

Checkout.title: Checkout
Checkout.description: Represents a user's end-of-day checkout update, linking back to their check-in.

userId.description: The ID of the user submitting the checkout.

avatar.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

tasks.description: A list of tasks from the daily check-in with their completion status.

reason.description: Reason if the task was not done.

learning.description: Key learnings or what to do differently next time.

tomorrowPlan.description: The user's stated priority for the next day.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of when the checkout was submitted.

Checkin.title: Checkin
Checkin.description: Represents a user's start-of-day check-in and plan.

mood.description: The user's self-reported mood for the day.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a single task or to-do item for a user.

TaskTemplate.title: Task Template
TaskTemplate.description: A reusable checklist for common tasks.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a high-level project with its own dashboard and metrics.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the project was created.

ImpactMetric.title: ImpactMetric
ImpactMetric.description: Represents a single, trackable impact metric.

CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent
CalendarEvent.description: Represents a single event on the organizational calendar.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Represents an alert or notification for users.

action.description: A URL link for the alert's call to action.

creatorId.description: The ID of the user who triggered the alert.

readBy.description: A list of user IDs who have read the alert.

targetUserIds.description: A list of user IDs this alert is specifically for. If empty, it's a broadcast.

KeyResult.title: Key Result
KeyResult.description: A key result from the October Operational Plan.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents a single expense report with multiple line items.

title.description: The overall title of the expense report (e.g., Mpigi Field Visit).

type.description: The type of expense report (pre-spending or post-spending).

items.description: A list of individual expense items.

totalAmount.description: The sum of all item amounts.

projectId.description: Optional ID of the project this expense belongs to.

projectName.description: Optional name of the project this expense belongs to.

Income.title: Income
Income.description: Represents a single income or revenue entry.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: Represents a single grant proposal or funding application.

TeamWeeklyPlan.title: Team Weekly Plan
TeamWeeklyPlan.description: A manager-created plan with high-level priorities for the entire team for a specific week.

weekOf.description: The start date of the week (e.g., a Monday).

keyPriorities.description: A list of the main team priorities for the week.

message.description: A brief message or focus from the manager for the week.

WeeklyWorkplan.title: Weekly Workplan
WeeklyWorkplan.description: Represents a user's finalized strategic plan for a specific week, built upon the team's plan.

teamPlanId.description: Reference to the TeamWeeklyPlan for that week. Optional.

teamPriorities.description: The inherited team priorities for the week. Optional.

individualTasks.description: The user's individual tasks for the week.

Equipment.title: Equipment
Equipment.description: Represents a piece of physical equipment or an asset.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single chat message in the team space.

Testimony.title: Testimony
Testimony.description: A recorded testimony, which can be text, audio, or video.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Stores user feedback on AI performance, bugs, or features.

flow.description: For 'ai' type, the name of the AI flow (e.g., dailyPlannerAIFlow).

description.description: For 'bug' or 'feature' type, the user's detailed report.

wasHelpful.description: For 'ai' type, whether the output was helpful.

Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: Represents a logged meeting or interaction with a partner.

HealthCheck.title: Health Check
HealthCheck.description: Represents a periodic health check for a partnership.

checkedBy.description: Name of the staff member who did the check.

SchoolApplication.title: School Application
SchoolApplication.description: An application submitted by a school to participate in Omuto programs.

Beneficiary.title: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.description: Represents a single beneficiary of Omuto's programs.

AttendanceRecord.title: Attendance Record
AttendanceRecord.description: Represents a single attendance record for a participant at an event or session.

BaselineSurvey.title: Baseline Survey
BaselineSurvey.description: Captures pre-program status of a beneficiary.

EndlineSurvey.title: Endline Survey
EndlineSurvey.description: Captures post-program status of a beneficiary.

MhmTraining.title: MHM Training
MhmTraining.description: Attendance for a Menstrual Health Management training session.

EnvironmentalClub.title: Environmental Club
EnvironmentalClub.description: Registration for a new GreenSchools environmental club.

WasteAudit.title: Waste Audit
WasteAudit.description: A waste audit report for a school.

SLF_School.title: SLF School
SLF_School.description: Registration for a school in the Student Leaders Forum.

SLF_Prefect.title: SLF Prefect
SLF_Prefect.description: Registration for a prefect in the Student Leaders Forum.

SLF_Training.title: SLF Training Attendance
SLF_Training.description: Attendance record for an SLF training session.

PrefectPerformance.title: Prefect Performance
PrefectPerformance.description: Monthly performance tracking for a prefect.

YoSkillsCircle.title: YoSkills Circle
YoSkillsCircle.description: An entrepreneurship circle under the YoSkills program.

YoSkillsYouth.title: YoSkills Youth
YoSkillsYouth.description: A youth participant in the YoSkills program.

YoSkillsSession.title: YoSkills Session
YoSkillsSession.description: Attendance for a YoSkills circle session.

BusinessIdea.title: Business Idea
BusinessIdea.description: A business idea submitted by a YoSkills participant.

PitchScore.title: Pitch Score
PitchScore.description: Scores for a business idea pitch.

BusinessProgress.title: Business Progress
BusinessProgress.description: Monthly progress tracking for a YoSkills business.

OFAPlayer.title: OFA Player
OFAPlayer.description: A player registered in the Omuto Football Alliance.

OFAMatch.title: OFA Match
OFAMatch.description: A match report for the Omuto Football Alliance.

OFAMatchSummary.title: OFA Match Summary
OFAMatchSummary.description: A simplified match report for district meets.

OFAAdvancedAnalysis.title: OFA Advanced Match Analysis
OFAAdvancedAnalysis.description: A detailed analysis report for tournament finals.

OFAEquipmentImpact.title: OFA Equipment Impact Tracker
OFAEquipmentImpact.description: Tracks the impact of equipment/support provided to teams.

PulseContent.title: Omuto Pulse Content
PulseContent.description: A content submission for Omuto Pulse.

ProductionLog.title: Production Log
ProductionLog.description: A log for Omuto Essentials production.

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: A sales record for Omuto Essentials.

InventoryCheck.title: Inventory Check
InventoryCheck.description: An inventory check for Omuto Essentials.

WaterSource.title: Water Source
WaterSource.description: A mapped water source for the PureWater Initiative.

WASH_Assessment.title: WASH Assessment
WASH_Assessment.description: A WASH assessment for a school.

YAP_Chapter.title: YAP Chapter
YAP_Chapter.description: A registered chapter in the Youth Action Pathway.

YAP_Report.title: YAP Monthly Report
YAP_Report.description: A monthly report from a YAP chapter.

SeedGrantApplication.title: Seed Grant Application
SeedGrantApplication.description: An application for a seed grant.

SeedGrantAccountability.title: Seed Grant Accountability
SeedGrantAccountability.description: Accountability report for a seed grant.

OFATeam.title: OFA Team
OFATeam.description: An OFA Team registered in the Omuto Football Alliance.

OFAVolunteer.title: OFA Volunteer
OFAVolunteer.description: A volunteer registration for an Omuto Cup event.

OFAScorecard.title: OFA Quarterly Scorecard
OFAScorecard.description: A quarterly performance scorecard for an OFA team.
